{{Quote|There hasn't been any legitimate business here in decades.|[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]|<ref name="O1" />}}
'''New Coronet''' was a primary [[City/Legends|port]]<ref name="CET">{{CSWECite|III|263|Trigalis}}</ref> on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CEC">{{CSWECite|II|373|New Coronet}}</ref> of [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]],<ref name="O1" /> a [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] planet.<ref name="CET" /> The city was designated in many travel guides as a trading post, but in reality, it was a collection of run-down buildings that served as a haven for all sorts of criminals.<ref name="CEC" />

During the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CET" /> New Coronet came under the control of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] assassin [[Xist]].<ref name="CEC" /> Five [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the end of the Clone Wars,<ref name="CET" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met up with [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] here while searching for [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="O1" />
